title: Rewrite the
thing they ignore
slides.body: One line in your copy is quietly costing you. Here are three weak versions and the rewrite for each. Steal them.

title: It isn't broken.
It's {{vague.}}
slides.body: People rarely reject you. They fail to understand you fast enough, then they leave. **Vague copy reads as a vague offer.** Three lines doing the damage, below.

slides.before: Put the weak, generic version here.

slides.takeaway: One line. The lesson, not the recap.

title: Say what you do.
Say who breaks without it.
Say it like a human.
slides.body: Do that and your copy stops sounding like everyone else's. Same offer. Completely different signal.

title: Find your weak line.
slides.body: Tell readers exactly what to do next. One action only — a free resource, a checklist, a DM, a booked call.
